items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 5 October 2026 4:47am
items.description:
##Today##

Largely cloudy morning with the chance of patchy light rain at times, then mainly dry afternoon with bright intervals. Outbreaks of rain late evening and overnight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 11°C and max. air temperature 17°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-3


##Wind Speed##

18


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

SW 15-20, occasionally 20-25 in places this morning, decreasing 10-15 this evening, veering N tonight.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, falling moderate in rain later. Occasional hill fog.


##Comments##

Occasional strong wind in places this morning.


##Tomorrow##

Occasional outbreaks of rain gradually clearing in the afternoon. Isolated showers late in the period.
